title: U.S. retail sales unexpectedly rise 0.6% in June
主要内容: U.S. retail sales unexpectedly rose 0.6% in June, surpassing expectations and indicating a rebound in consumer spending. The Commerce Department reported that retail sales increased by 0.6% last month, with May data revised downward to show a 1.7% decline instead of the previously reported 1.3%. Economists had forecast a 0.4% drop, but the actual data showed a stronger performance. Sales surged 18.0% compared to June 2020, reflecting a return to pre-pandemic levels. Demand for goods like electronics and motor vehicles remained strong, although the automotive sector faced challenges due to a global semiconductor shortage. Spending is shifting back to services such as travel and entertainment, with over 160 million Americans fully vaccinated against COVID-19. Retail sales are mostly goods, with services like healthcare, education, and travel making up the remaining portion. U.S. stock index futures held gains after the data, while U.S. Treasury yields rose. Core retail sales, excluding automobiles, gasoline, building materials, and food services, increased 1.1% in June, aligning with the consumer spending component of GDP.
